latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with comprehensive construction project management features:

- Supports full project lifecycle management, including scheduling, budgets, subcontractors, materials, safety, quality, and client communication.
- Automated heartbeat cycle flags schedule risks, missing reports, cost overruns, overdue RFIs/submittals, and safety issues.
- Structured tools for project scheduling, milestone and critical path tracking, and 3-week look-ahead generation.
- Detailed daily site report template and process requirements.
- Subcontractor registry, pay application, insurance/bond tracking, and monthly performance logging.
- Material procurement workflow with lead-time tracking and delivery management.
- Budget tracking by cost code, with variance analysis and proactive alerts.
